# Chuck Rice Labs

> Interactive experiments by Chuck Rice, a product designer who ships production code. Each lab is a small, dependency-free web page; every one has a "Behind the design" write-up explaining the choices. Source: https://github.com/chuckwired/labs

## Labs
- [RuneScape Capes of Accomplishment](https://labs.chuckwired.com/rs2-capes/): As a kid, I spent hours fawning over digital capes you get from making unreasonable commitments to clicking stuff. Now I can just code 'em up. Who'd have thought!?
- [Ocean](https://labs.chuckwired.com/ocean/): As realistic a sea as I could get without a single library, at golden hour or sunset. Somewhere out there, a penguin. Look for it.
- [Pipes](https://labs.chuckwired.com/windows-pipes/): The Windows XP screensaver I could have watched for hours. Copper and cyan pipes grow, turn and fill the void.

## Behind the design

## About the site
- [Performance](https://labs.chuckwired.com/performance/): how the site is built, what each page weighs, and how it handles performance, accessibility and search.
- [Impact](https://labs.chuckwired.com/impact/): how engagement is measured without cookies, what the research says about time on page, and what visitors have said.
- [Portfolio](https://chuckwired.com) and [writing](https://chuckwired.medium.com) by the same author.
